name: 에스텔
visual_review: 갈색 단발과 붉은 눈, 소방복·방패·도끼를 유지했습니다. 무전·신호·물폭탄 대비·웅크림·회수 동작과 작은 헬기/물보라가 원작 R을 나타냅니다.
motion_summary: Estelle brown-haired firefighter red-black uniform, huge rescue shield and red fireaxe from identity. Official self-target R requests helicopter support and releases water bomb on her location. Animate upright guarded idle; briefly lifting hand to radio by cheek; looking upward; extending arm signal; bracing shield up at shoulder without covering eyes; a tiny rescue helicopter appears above-right within its cell; water canister drops at right; crouching behind shield as blue-white water splashes on ground; rising through water droplets; axe lowers to side; shield folds to idle; original idle. Keep helicopter small, no giant scenery. Actual radio arm, signal, knees/shield movements.
